crossRefs.note: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.
For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.
When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
Jonathan, Saul’s son, arose, and went to David into the woods, and strengthened his hand in God.
Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, ‘Don’t lodge tonight at the fords of the wilderness, but by all…
Arise, let’s be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”
While he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and…
since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?
They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.
The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
“How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools…
He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.
But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.
For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,

translations.web: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.
translations.bsb: Those who follow after wickedness draw near; they are far from Your law.
translations.kjv: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.
translations.asv: They draw nigh that follow after wickedness; They are far from thy law.
